title: TAI agro-wide model-first routing and REG.RU activation repair
objective: Ensure every safe question with any reasonable connection to agriculture, gardens, orchards, fields, villages, livestock, agricultural machinery, storage, logistics, farm economics or farm IT reaches local Qwen as general_agro and cannot resolve to an unrelated platform article.
boundaries: Every POST to /api/public-platform-assistant is rewritten to /api/agro-chat before legacy filesystem route resolution
GET /api/public-platform-assistant remains the read-only starter-prompt catalog
Live acceptance covers crops, gardens, orchards, soils, irrigation, livestock, poultry, beekeeping, agricultural machinery, grain storage, farm economics, village infrastructure and farm IT
Short follow-up questions inherit agricultural context
RU is mandatory and representative EN and ZH cases are mandatory
Every accepted answer must use tai-qwen3-8b-q4km in general_agro mode, mention the actual subject and contain at least two domain-relevant factors
Agricultural questions must not receive platform data-protection, RBAC, session, tenant-isolation or audit boilerplate unless the user asks about those subjects
Activation controller input, state and output use a numeric attempt-scoped identifier derived from github.run_id and github.run_attempt
An unexpected attempt-id collision fails closed and does not delete or chmod an existing protected directory
Private mode, signed sessions, role propagation, tenant isolation, secret handling, write authority and current-evidence controls remain unchanged
No hard-coded agronomic dose is introduced without soil, crop, region and production inputs
No paid model, SaaS, database, hosting service or recurring cost is added

Production completion requires exact-head CI, exact-main merge, canonical images, REG.RU deployment, preflight, restricted Qwen activation and finalization, direct SSE and 390x844 mobile Chromium acceptance
PostgreSQL, audit and outbox authority must remain PASS
